chapter_keywords: true sutra of the fire vestments
chapter_seo_title: Dao-Guai Yi-Xian Chapter 358 — Li Huowang’s Identity Hidden by Zhuge Yuan’s Gift
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang tries to kill everyone after thinking his Heart-Element identity is exposed. But Zhuge Yuan’s mysterious spindle has been hiding him all along.
og_description: Li Huowang’s paranoia peaks, but a forgotten gift from Zhuge Yuan changes everything he thought he knew.
twitter_description: Li Huowang tries to burn everyone alive—only to realize they never saw what he feared they did.

lore_anchors.definition: A corrupted counterpart to the Heart-Element. Its ability is to "hide" or erase concepts, objects, and memories from reality, rather than making fictions real.
An object left by Zhuge Yuan; later proves to be a valuable concealment or utility artifact, capable of substituting for the copper coin mask in hiding the Heart-Element identity.
A high-ranking eunuch official in the Supervisory Heavenly Office; their power is both bureaucratic and supernatural, often wielded through a deceptively genial demeanor.
A foundational artifact of a suffering-cult, whose methods involve trading extreme agony for power from Bashe. Li Huowang discards it to extinguish his self-inflicted fire.
A sacred text of the Ao-Jing Sect; when burned, it releases a fire-slug for agonizing, flesh-sealing healing.
A powerful sword of the “military path” that corrupts a normal user’s personality with overwhelming bloodlust and aggression.
A rare human constitution valuable as an alchemical ingredient; Li Huowang is identified as such, making him a target for practitioners seeking rare ingredients.
